svg.title: DeeWaanAI OS layer stack and authority boundaries
svg.text: DeeWaanAI OS layer stack and authority boundaries
source: brief.md §5 (contract boundaries) + §4.2 (audit ownership)
Qafiya
owns/consumes: records, bindings, write-back, invalidation, chained history
must not: mutate JSON directly or bypass checks
L2
owns/consumes: dvr/1.1 validation, rendering, edits, evidence
must not: add roles/kinds or merge bindings locally
L3
owns/consumes: action records, grants, confirmation, execution, undo
must not: treat button rendering as execution authority
L4
owns/consumes: memory read/write, inspection, correction/deletion protocols
must not: edit active memory or history directly
L5
owns/consumes: route decisions, user connection list, health and cost records
must not: select models, infer prices, or store secrets
L6 Shell
owns/consumes: joins L1-L5; owns ds:shell_audit
must not: reimplement lower-layer authority
